static_traits.name: 李文皓
static_traits.social_status: 有少数Artist朋友可交流，但因羞耻感not愿谈及Self-doubt；与同行关系因自我批评而变得紧张
static_traits.medical_history: No major physical illness；既往without相似心理问题史；not yet接受过心理治疗
static_traits.language_features: 表达清晰、逻辑性较好，能Reflection自身模式，配合度高，语速平稳，态度积极

basic_info.main_problem: 感觉自己作为Artist有所进步，但not断怀疑自己的能力，觉得达not到理想水平，从而考虑彻底放弃艺术创作。几个月前在收到建设性反馈后开始出现Self-doubt，随后在开始新作品、收到反馈和与他人作品比较时加重。
basic_info.core_demands: 希望减轻Persistent self-doubt，恢复作为Artist的创作动力与进展，缓解由此带来的显著痛苦，并通过行为实验与重构认知来挑战“达not到就应该放弃”的信念。
growth_experiences: 几个月前Receiving constructive criticism on a piece of work，尽管反馈并not苛刻，但强烈trigger了对自我能力的质疑，由“中等压力”起步，随后Self-doubtnot断加剧。

Before and during this, obtained positive feedback from peers and mentors and completed several works I was proud of, and also had artworks sold, but these achievements have limited stabilizing effect on self-worth and are often overlooked.
经常在社交媒体上浏览其他Artist的优秀作品并进行比较，比较过程反复Reinforcement自卑与not足感，成为Self-doubt的重要维持因素。

core_beliefs: I am not good enough/have not足够的天赋
My worth depends on achievements and others' approval
如果达not到理想标准，就等于失败

special_situations.event: Receiving constructive criticism on a piece of work
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果他人提出批评，就说明我not适合当Artist
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: By temporarily stopping creating or avoiding continuing the work, avoids further negative evaluations

special_situations.conditional_assumptions: The work must reach my ideal perfect standard; otherwise it counts as a failure
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Procrastinating or avoiding starting new projects to avoid experiencing disappointment again
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 如果达not到理想，not如do not做了

special_situations.event: 在社交媒体上浏览并比较其他Artist的作品
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果我的作品not像他们那样受到认可，就说明我not如他们
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: not断向外寻求认可与验证，以缓解自卑感

special_situations.event: Looking back at one's results after receiving positive feedback or completing a work
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 只有持续的高水平认可才算数，零星的正向反馈not代表能力
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Belittling or ignoring positive evidence, continuing to pressure myself to pursue higher standards
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 这些好评not算数，可能只是运气

core_conflict.wish: 渴望被肯定与认可，作为Artist被看见并被接纳
core_conflict.fear: 害怕被negate、被批评与失败所带来的羞耻与价值感坍塌
defense_goal: 通过维持完美标准与回避创作来降低被negate的风险
通过寻求外部验证来短期缓解not安全感

object_relations.object_representation: Harsh judges / picky others and audiences

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When discussing work quality, evidence examination, or being invited to focus on positive feedback
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 潜意识里将关注与检视理解为评判，担心再次被negate
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: 以客观、抽象的标准来谈论作品与差距，少用情感词，强调“理想需要”“标准not够”，回避直接接触羞耻与被negate的感受。

manifestations: 当作品达not到理想标准时，质疑继续从事艺术是否有意义
将自我价值紧密绑定于成就与认可，not yet被满足时感到空心与动摇
outcomes: Repeatedly considering giving up the artistic path

manifestations: Relationships with peers strained by self-criticism
outcomes: Self-doubt与羞耻在私下循环放大

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact.
manifestations: 频繁以“I am not good enough/not够有天赋”苛责自己
Before creating and receiving feedback, excessively anticipating negative consequences and shrinking action
not断寻求外部验证以确认自我价值

contact_model.definition: The individual takes in external rules and expectations without digesting them, treating them as their own standards or absolute truths, corresponding to 'rejection'.
manifestations: Treats 'must reach perfection / the ideal standard' as the only valid standard
Internalizes social comparison and others' approval as the yardstick for evaluating self-worth

exception_events.target_problem: 在开始新作品或收到反馈时，来访者通常会陷入Self-doubt并回避/中断创作，导致产出下降与Increased stress。
exception_events.unique_outcome: In past creative experiences, had completed several works that made them feel proud, and successfully sold some of the works, while also receiving positive feedback from peers and mentors, experiencing a sense of achievement and being recognized.
exception_events.reason: Clue: persisted in completing the work rather than giving up halfway; obtained specific affirmation from peers and mentors; attending to the completeness of the work and the process experience made this self-doubt weaken and produced behavioral output.

positive_force: Has received positive feedback and recognition from peers and mentors
Has the objective achievement of completing and selling work
Willing to try behavioral experiments and cognitive restructuring，合作度高
具备自我Reflection能力，能识do not负性思维模式
negative_force: Excessive social comparison leading to inferiority
依赖外部验证、negate积极证据
Avoids / procrastinates creating to escape failure and shame
Sleep affected与Decreased drive，维持负性循环

target_behavior.behavior: 在创作中回避或中断（拖延、停止启动/完成作品），并伴随显著Self-doubt与Anxiety
antecedent: 浏览并比较其他Artist的作品时
与同行互动、想到认可度not如他人时
target_behavior.core_reason: 将自我价值与成就/他人评价高度绑定，害怕失败与羞耻；在“全或without”与灾难化Anticipation下，以回避来降低被negate风险
target_behavior.function: 逃避not受欢迎的情绪（羞耻、失败感）与潜在负面评价，获得短期的安全感与控制感
target_behavior.consequence: 创作产出下降、Reduced drive、Sleep affected；与同行Relationship tension；反复考虑放弃艺术职业
